svg.text: CB2-J01 · Hinge, locks and local frame mounting
Nominal geometry only. Pin clearance is modeled; tolerances and strength are not approved.

FRAME CONNECTION · FRONT DATUMS (rear mirrored)
Outriggers: 2 × 4 × 1/4 HSS at X −46 and −4; Y −53 to −36
Inner trimmer: 4 × 2 × 1/8; X −44.5 to −5.5, Y −39 to −37
Shorten end crossmember at X −25 to Y −39..−36; do not cut the main girder
Outer perimeter opening X −44.75..−5.25; deck recess Y −55..−39
Pin/bush materials, machining fits, weld sizing and cut-end closures require engineering release.
Exploded 3D also separates flight, deck panels and retained hardware; no eight-bolt removal routine.
